purpose: AIBL cohort for AD-immune post-build VALs (CPG-VAL-008 through CPG-VAL-014). Streaming extraction of the 14,018-CpG union (Walther class+celltype markers ∪ v0_2 markers ∪ age layer ∪ AD Rule A panel ∪ IMM_CPGS_RAW panel) from GEO series matrix.
authored_by: Walther (Claude) per Heath's 2026-06-02 directive to acquire cohorts via SOP v1.2

cohort_source_paper.citation: Nabais et al. 2021 AIBL DNA methylation. Australian Imaging, Biomarker and Lifestyle (AIBL) study release.

extracted_cpg_union.missing_note: Likely 450K-only CpGs from the v0_2 markers or age layer. EPIC platform doesn't carry every 450K probe.

files.name: GSE153712_betas_union.csv
files.schema: CpGs as rows (13,384), samples as columns (726). First column = cpg_id, header row = sentrix sample IDs.

files.name: cpg_extraction_manifest.json
files.schema: per-set breakdown of the CpG union (Walther + v0_2 + age + panels)

stage_1_reproduction_check_2026_06_02.description: Sanity check that post-build extracted β reproduces pre-build VAL-051 Rule A 7-CpG directional signal
stage_1_reproduction_check_2026_06_02.scoring: A_dir = Σ z-score × direction; HC mean/SD as reference
stage_1_reproduction_check_2026_06_02.interpretation: Full-cohort d=+0.615 is consistent with VAL-051 holdout d=+0.624. Slight reduction is expected (panel selection bias on training data inflated the holdout estimate vs population). Extraction is verified.

sex_stratified.interpretation: Sex-stratified d values match pre-build directionally (F > M). Magnitudes within sampling variation.
